description: Resolve a player name to canonical TheSportsDB records with player ID, full name, current team, position, nationality, birth date, and thumbnail URL.

query.description: Player name or partial name to search, e.g. "Shohei Ohtani", "LeBron", "Messi".

sport.description: Advisory sport hint for disambiguation, e.g. "Baseball", "Soccer", or "Basketball". Matching players are returned regardless of this value.

name: sports_find_player

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No player matched the query in TheSportsDB. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

birthDate.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, or null if not available.

nationality.description: Player nationality, or null if not available.

position.description: Playing position, or null if not available.

source.description: Data source for this player record — always thesportsdb.

team.description: Current team name, or null if not available.

thumbnailUrl.description: Player thumbnail image URL, or null if not available.

title: Sports Find Player
